start-here-overview--docs.title: Start Here/Overview
start-here-overview--docs.content:
import { Meta } from "@storybook/addon-docs/blocks"; import { AreaCards, Folders, NextPages, OverviewHero, WhatsNew } from "./overview-sections"; import { Callout, Page, Section } from "./ui";
How it's built: React 19 and TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4.2 with Fox's semantic tokens, React Aria for accessibility, Untitled UI React components and Storybook 10. The three prototypes are Next.js 16 static sites. All four deploy to GitHub Pages in one build. Press / to search the sidebar.

start-here-process-roadmap--docs.content:
import { Meta } from "@storybook/addon-docs/blocks";
import { AlsoOpen, ComingUp, OpenDecisions, ProcessHero, ProcessSteps, ShippedList } from "./process-sections";
import { Page, Section } from "./ui";

<Meta title="Start Here/Process & roadmap" />

<Page>

<ProcessHero />

<Section title="How work flows" intro="Five steps, the same every round.">
    <ProcessSteps />
</Section>

<Section
    title="Coming up: Crane Web takes over"
    intro="On the Nov 11 call, the team decided that Crane Web replaces Fox as TenFore's live golfer web app: the web shop and booking site. Fox stays as the home of the MCG prototypes, and the ideas Crane Web builds from."
>
    <ComingUp />
</Section>

<Section
    id="open-decisions"
    title="Open decisions: the lesson-software replacement"
    intro="Eight questions for Weston, from Linear project P-WJ-118 on the WJ team. Justin proposed answers on Nov 3; the answer to D-2 came from the backend team on Nov 13. All eight wait for Weston to confirm."
>
    <OpenDecisions />
</Section>

<Section title="Also open">
    <AlsoOpen />
</Section>

<Section title="What has shipped" intro="Every change merged to main, newest first, with its pull request number. Underlined lines open what they shipped.">
    <ShippedList />
</Section>

</Page>
